description: This file is a JavaScript module generated by Emscripten that loads and initializes a WebAssembly module for running .NET runtime components in a web environment. It handles environment detection, file system setup, memory management, and WebAssembly instantiation.

classes.name: ExceptionInfo

methods.description: Increments the count of run dependencies for the asynchronous instantiation process.

methods.name: removeRunDependency
methods.description: Decrements the run dependency count and triggers callback if all dependencies are fulfilled.

methods.name: instantiateArrayBuffer

methods.name: createWasm
methods.description: Handles the process of loading and instantiating the WebAssembly module, setting up environment and memory views.
